name: Xianhe Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xianhe Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of high-performance paper-based functional materials, pulp raw materials, and chemical raw materials in China and internationally. The company offers specialty paper products, such as paper for the tobacco industry, home decoration paper, business communication and anti-counterfeiting paper, food and medical packaging paper, label release paper, heat transfer base paper, paper for low-quantitative publishing and printing, electrical and industrial paper, as well as specialty pulp and decorative base paper products.
